videos.descricao:
Kenji broke his grandmother's favorite bowl, hid the pieces and lied about it. Every lie made the guilt bigger, until one rainy night he had to choose between hiding it forever and telling the truth. What his grandmother did with the broken pieces changed how he sees mistakes.

Animated stories about discipline, with one Japanese idea in every film.
